from pocket_coffea.lib.cut_functions import get_nObj_eq, get_nObj_min
from pocket_coffea.lib.categorization import MultiCut, CartesianSelection

# Define jet multiplicity cuts
jet_4 = get_nObj_eq(4, coll="JetGood", name="4j")
jet_5 = get_nObj_eq(5, coll="JetGood", name="5j")
jet_6 = get_nObj_min(6, coll="JetGood", name="6j")

# Define b-tag multiplicity cuts
btag_2 = get_nObj_eq(2, coll="BJetGood", name="2b")
btag_3 = get_nObj_min(3, coll="BJetGood", name="3b")

# Create MultiCut objects for each binning
jet_binning = MultiCut(
    name="jet_multiplicity",
    cuts=[jet_4, jet_5, jet_6],
    cuts_names=["4j", "5j", "6j"]
)

btag_binning = MultiCut(
    name="btag_multiplicity",
    cuts=[btag_2, btag_3],
    cuts_names=["2b", "3b"]
)

# Create cartesian product of binnings
categories = CartesianSelection(
    multicuts=[jet_binning, btag_binning]
)

# Access category names
category_names = categories.keys()
print(f"Analysis categories: {category_names}")
# Output: ['4j_2b', '4j_3b', '5j_2b', '5j_3b', '6j_2b', '6j_3b']
